code: (()=>{window.__sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));window.__move=async(x,y)=>{window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',{clientX:x,clientY:y,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));await window.__sleep(35);return window.__echoes.state().party[0].aim;};window.__aim=async(wx,wz)=>{const e=window.__echoes;let sx=innerWidth/2,sy=innerHeight/2;let a=await window.__move(sx,sy);for(let i=0;i<25&&a;i++){const d=Math.hypot(wx-a.x,wz-a.z);if(d<0.02)return{ok:true,sx,sy,aim:a,i,d};const h=20;const ax=await window.__move(sx+h,sy);const ay=await window.__move(sx,sy+h);const j11=(ax.x-a.x)/h,j12=(ay.x-a.x)/h,j21=(ax.z-a.z)/h,j22=(ay.z-a.z)/h;const det=j11*j22-j12*j21;if(Math.abs(det)<1e-12)break;const ex=wx-a.x,ez=wz-a.z;let dsx=(j22*ex-j12*ez)/det,dsy=(-j21*ex+j11*ez)/det;const L=Math.hypot(dsx,dsy),cap=400;if(L>cap){dsx*=cap/L;dsy*=cap/L;}sx=Math.max(3,Math.min(innerWidth-3,sx+dsx));sy=Math.max(3,Math.min(innerHeight-3,sy+dsy));a=await window.__move(sx,sy);}return{ok:false,sx,sy,aim:a};};window.__press=(code)=>{window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));};window.__ev=(T,types)=>window.__echoes.events.filter(e=>e.tick>=T&&types.includes(e.type));'ready'})()
